Deer mouse ( Peromyscus maniculatus ) (Per https://www.nps.gov/mora/learn/nature/rodents.htm#CP_JUMP_677822 the "deer mouse" in that national park is P. maniculatus)
A beige mouse with darkened back blends with dried mud under the green grasses. Rodents provide a major food source for prairie predators. Keywords: mouse; mice; rodent
